title: Local directory
idea: Local directory: A real geographic coverage view is paired with a browsable service list and explicit boundary conditions.
audience: People who need to find local service within a marketing surface.
avoidWhen: Coverage cannot be checked against real data.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic spatial layout through its find local service priority and explicit commitment contract: Confirm actual area eligibility before showing a service as available.
navigation: Local directory keeps the current find local service context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A real geographic coverage view is paired with a browsable service list and explicit boundary conditions.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to find local service; available service depends on location.
composition.priority: Confirm actual area eligibility before showing a service as available.

imagery.role: Support the actual find local service context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Offer a list-first phone layout with a deliberate map switch and persistent selection.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the local directory structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no find local service content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Confirm actual area eligibility before showing a service as available.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized find local service content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Confirm actual area eligibility before showing a service as available.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active find local service context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
